notes.title: Pride Run - First Major Update
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
Today we have uploaded our first major update, that contains:
- Free Artworks DLC (!!!)
- Multiple endings (4 new endings!)
- Japanese Language
- Fixed Vanilla Mode problem
- Added visual feedbacks for Multiplayer

In details:

[h1][b]Free Artworks DLC[/b][/h1]
Soon (this evening? tomorrow morning?) it will be available a free DLC with all the artworks made during the production of Pride Run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/47ceaf7be1f6401a4fd884a0874c15efc16226e0.gif[/img]




[h1][b]Multiple Endings[/b][/h1]
As some of you know, there were four different endings for Pride Run. Now they're doubled!
You can find 8 different versions of the finale, and we are going to publish more details about them next days (so stay tuned on steam hub!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/8d83345ab48803025b5ffc17ae4c467f67356777.gif[/img]




[h1][b]Added Japanese Language[/b][/h1]
Now you can play Pride Run also in Japanese!
(The other languagues in which the game is available are: english, german, italian, french, spanish and portoguese).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/0a7d5896d3834bdba73a0a210689bcde6b3d0150.png[/img]




[h1][b]Vanilla Mode Fix[/b][/h1]
As some users noticed: there was a small gap between the center of the button you had to press, and the rhytm of the music.
We fixed it: for some reason the game started a frame ahead with the visualization of the sequence.

For reference:  you have to press the button when the bar is in the center of the button in order to make a Pride Hit:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/4adc755cfcf7a40778f247ef4f8ae19a0edea12b.png[/img]

In this case I didn't hit the perfect center, but there's an offset on the left and right that permits the pride hit also if you're not in the correct millisecond (it will be unplayable otherwise).




[h1][b]Multiplayer Visual Feedback[/b][/h1]
We added an additional feedback for multiplayer Vanilla:
- If all the users play correctly, then a rainbow appears
- If some users make mistakes, the rainbow become more and more transparent (if all the players miss the hit, then no rainbow :( )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/6a1192448f7de830610767e235f317eea209e891.gif[/img]



[b]As always: Run Pride Run![/b]

notes.title: THE GLTB MUSEUM of CASTRO
notes.content:
Hello beautiful people!

Let us show you pictures of our visit in the [b]GLBT museum of Castro[/b].
[url=https://www.glbthistory.org/museum-about-visitor-info]Here the website[/url].

While the last GDC 2019, some of us were at the [b]DNA Lounge[/b], to dance and have fun in the Gay Gamer Professional Party (WHAT A GREAT NIGHT!).
Here a poster of DNA Lounge when it was one of the central points of GLBT culture.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/42b480d952273f93f24da7f5f783ae25f908911c.jpg[/img]

Because, [b]IF I CAN'T DANCE TO IT, IT'S NOT MY REVOLUTION[/b]!
(cit. Emma Goldman)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/b425f6060c1e6218617bea4965fc1d6e9cea3f44.jpg[/img]

Do you know who the [b]Two Spirits[/b] are? The LGBT native indians. In that community, LGBT people were considered a richness, as they meant two spirits in one body.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/9de2342305af30cdd8be94db7c21f222e21c610e.jpg[/img]
In SF every year you'll find the B.A.A.I.T.S., Bay Area American Indian Two-Spirits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/79079a6d60560ba6b7d0720c9fac5489323f4862.jpg[/img]

Here [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Del_Martin_and_Phyllis_Lyon]Del Martin & Phyllis Lion[/url], the Daughters of Bilits: the beginning of Lesbian Activism:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/0c4a40fd89d18d7084b689fa82d015b73ac4a32a.jpg[/img]

The beginning of the culture of leather: [b]Fe-Be's Leather David[/b]. Fe-Be's was the first leather bar in Folsom Street.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/f1c41a5368042e93082bc5f7095afb4bd6c391b7.jpg[/img]

Do you know [b]why California is named California[/b]? Thanks to [b]Queen Califia[/b], queen of warrior women.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/6dfcd5d7db2cce77d401368267c7a7c466e69a50.jpg[/img]

Now a curious story. [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finocchio%27s_Club]Joe Finocchio[/url], ante litteram drag queen:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/d9d5a1cb525e33e57b72ff7a411a967b4e2e3439.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/2c3e200b3fa57f2d03325c175f812a3984f0a1ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/9420157a63e4a861bed4119d0ef91feb7d2ef3ba.jpg[/img]
The curious thing is that in Italian, "Finocchio" means fennel, but it is used as a (bad) way to say "gay". So, this is why.

Finally, let's give a look to this suit. IT was Harvey Milk's one, when he was killed in San Francisco the 27 november 1978.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/02dc76e4018c2b09a92be9ead8d1f0517d8a93ba.jpg[/img]
You can see the blood on it.
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harvey_Milk]Who was Harvey Milk.[/url]

That day not only Milk was killed. Also the city major [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Moscone]George Moscone[/url].

[b]Well. Some of you every year goes to GDC or for some other important event, in the Moscone Center.
Now you know why Moscone Center is called Moscone Center[/b].

notes.title: PRIDE RUN RADIO... do you know Castro?
notes.content:
When we were in San Francisco for the Game Developer Conference, we did a walkaround in Castro, the historical LGBTQ+ neighborhood of San Francisco.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/0d7d0cfd5dbd190ba080fc4c9949b675fe2b3f67.jpg[/img]
We arrived there to visit the place where Milk began the LGBTQ+ revolution in San Francisco. To see the place with our eyes and to smell the colors of the sky.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/7905d600bbd48155719cf0679d3e0316ba4b712f.jpg[/img]
On the sidewalk, we found portraits of superimportant LGBT people, as Sylvester and Alan Touring, the guy who created the first mechanical computer, used to decrypt the Nazi Enigma code, and then thanked with law penalty for his homosexuality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/4b3a719cda55ee6e5ceccffff224932901273419.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/a2463230e866d633d2053d31880141fc16849e51.jpg[/img]
Everywhere rainbows!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/59b72ee7eef633dcba07d0ef0a5a525199aab6a8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/8af9f3cdf4f5f547fd73089fe9a03bd7dc1fc5d5.jpg[/img]
It was time of Bohemian Rapdosy, the hyperfamous movie on the life of Freddie Mercury, the Queen. Wonderful small theatre.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/b0beb6c05deb40eb90f8ce3c48151336a013c983.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/f1ca7a6033cb68df8eb4d06097755f65d9a1d764.jpg[/img]
Then the end of the street!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/192a07f9d565afab65d3ed1d9bd877bdcba008bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/78b27fece54b1cad6d864e8027f5f8a67e6fb31e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/089ddc3f3daa55a5a367846ed1ed78747bef405e.jpg[/img]

Then, we went to take a coffe in Harvey's bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/6d48ff83da757766192133658b9aec4724b10dcd.jpg[/img]
We sat down while neighboorhood people was slowly arriving, having glances of the street.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/64f1be6f46bc0a9e2f50f32865efbbff2fde7ca5.jpg[/img]
This was the table where Harvey Milk used to sit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/b0b88dce30924d609f973ecfc931120d5ec551c2.jpg[/img]
What an emotion!
We sat down a moment where he spent his time with the people he loved.

Then, we moved to the GLBT museum. Next post!

notes.title: PRIDE RUN RADIO... working hard!
Pride Run will be supporting Kaleidoscope Trust
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/271c2eb7ccaeeb707c5f34aa7ba5db9cd874a058.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32922079/1e9de9ddc76fb6b24d79cf854f1d686331621564.png[/img]

Green Man Gaming Publishing has announced that it will donate 10 percent of sales income from its game Pride Run to the Kaleidoscope Trust.

The company said: “Green Man Gaming Publishing and Kaleidoscope Trust, a charity working to uphold the rights of lesbian, gay, bisexual and trans people internationally, today announce a revenue donation partnership, with proceeds coming from the sales of the upcoming rhythm action game, Pride Run.”

[previewyoutube=NKD5Cq--o2c;full][/previewyoutube]

GMG Publishing’s Managing Director David Clark said: “Since before we announced Pride Run back in July, the most important goals for Green Man Gaming have been to really get behind our corporate values of inclusivity and diversity.  We’re very happy to be able to demonstrate this through our partnership with Kaleidoscope Trust, where we’ll be able to donate to a great cause that works to uphold the rights of the LGBTQ+ community internationally.”

Kaleidoscope Trust Executive Director Phyll Opoku-Gyimah added: “At Kaleidoscope Trust we believe it should never be illegal to be you, yet over 70 countries make it a crime for LGBT+ people to be who they are and to love who they love. In many countries around the world people cannot live freely as LGBT+ individuals, much less attend Pride events where they live. We are therefore delighted to announce our partnership with Green Man Gaming and are pleased that the company has such an inclusive policy in what we understand can sometimes be a toxic environment for LGBT+ gamers.”

Opoku-Gyimah continued: “Through the launch of Pride Run, we hope to harness the support of the gaming community not only to raise funds for the work that Kaleidoscope Trust does to advance LGBT+ rights internationally, but to help open up conversations within the gaming community – and beyond – about discrimination against LGBT+ people around the world.”

Ivan Venturi, CEO & Game Director of Pride Run developer IV Productions also chipped in: “We’re a diverse development team, and many of us have been lucky enough to attend different Pride events around the world. We felt it was about time someone gamified the sheer energy, passion and extravagance that emanates from these celebrations of LGBTQ+ culture. Even better when we can celebrate Pride and give back to the community at the same time.”

Pride Run is a rhythm-action game with unmistakable hyper-colored retro pixel art-style graphics. Green Man Gaming Publishing said: “Much more than a simple beat matching game, Pride Run offers a challenge for gamers of all abilities. With ‘Vanilla’ mode tasking the player to keep their own Pride parade on track, they are required to ‘tap the beat’. However, more experienced players can choose ‘Play Hard’ mode which layers on real-time tactics and strategy as they battle to protect the parade from haters around the globe.”

Pride Run will be released for PC on Steam on 11 October 2019 – National Coming Out Day in the US. For more information visit http://www.priderunvideogame.it/

notes.title: Pride Run Menus
notes.content:
Hi there!
I'm here again to talk about a new PrideRun-Related topic... [b]MAIN MENU[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/1e9de9ddc76fb6b24d79cf854f1d686331621564.png[/img]

First, the main screen appears and you're asked to choose where you want to go. If you choose "start" then the all-in-one screen appears: here you can chose what mode/difficulty you want to play, and based on your choice [u]all the menu graphic changes[/u]!


[table] [tr]

[td]
Vanilla Mode - Single player: HEARTS
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/eb73ee364c6993b13968972f6d588252c5118c57.png[/img]
[/td] 

[td]
Vanilla Mode - Multiplayer: LIPS
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/f05576871cf7d0485ad6a05897b46178e54a6975.png[/img]
[/td] 
[/tr] 
[tr]
[td]
Play Hard - Single Player: STARS
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/9ef107886c769f7e7d48316e669de064016919ed.png[/img]
[/td] 

[td]
Play Hard - Multiplayer: DILDOS
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/ddeb603e1d982d33fa6a64a0557cb8e7d43a7819.png[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]

[/table]

After you make your choice the world map appears, where you can choose the city you want to play in.

notes.title: Layers of music!
notes.content:
Hi beautiful people!

I would like, if I may, to take you on a strange journey... but not in the Rocky Horror Picture Show. Let's trip in the Pride Run music!

Play Hard is the musical RTS game mode where you have to manage groups and leaders to get the best results and reach the higher Pride as possible.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/b8da799b841cb56c5115453bfb8d8906f64de763.png[/img]
And you hear the music following the Pride level: as much the Pride bar (the rainbow in the top of the screen) becomes wider, as more the Pride is high!
And as much the Pride is high, as more the music become louder!

We don't use volume to do this, but different modular layers of music, loops of base, instruments and vocals which can be overlayed composing dinamically the music.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/a9fc741683a2c39856665202423d2b34e46fdd8d.png[/img]

[url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/p076frem4gbmvjh/MUS_PSA_long%20version_PLAYHARD_demo.mp3?dl=0]Here an example, from Pisa funky seventiees scenario[/url].

You can hear the different layers, adding themselves on the previous ones loop after loop.

In the game, dinamically, if the Pride is too low, you will hear the base filtered, having the same impression you have when you hear the music playing in the hall but you are in the bathroom.

Normally, we use BASE, two or three different INSTRUMENTS layers, then the higher one: Hard Ton's VOCALS!

Mauro produces the main music theme, then Marianna takes the source project and uses all instruments to produce the loopable modular music layers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/b5ea54931291f3687a04bfdde9bfcd403b58fd33.jpg[/img]
(Marianna is the first girl on the right; in the middle Daniele, scenarios pixel artist; on the left Luisa, scenario pixel artist)

We hope you will enjoy the Pride Run music while playing and supporting LGBTQ+ rights!!!

RUN PRIDE RUN!!!

notes.title: Building the action on the music!
notes.content:
Here we are!
Let's talk about music and playing with it!

Since the first moment we thought of the game, we wanted Pride Run to be a musical game, with new game mechanics based on music, but more than all, about the pleasure of music.

We decided for two game modes: [b]Vanilla Mode[/b], which is the Rhythm’n game mode (more traditional design), and [b]Play Hard[/b], musical real time strategy game mode (more original design).
Rhythm’n games are not difficult to design. They’re simple. As it is simple when you hear music and you start to dance. We struggled on how to keep this simplicity without making the game too simple. It seems easy: the “phisycal” action of pressing buttons following the rhythm, with the needed speed without losing a beat. But, not easy, being sure that the action will be different for every scenario and every music.

We built a production pipeline like this:
1)	Mauro (Hard Ton) makes the music
2)	Designers (Ivan, Michele and Max) find the right mood for that music, for example “let’s use buttons as a cross on the refrain, then stop stop, relax, then superclimax with a superquick sequence”. Obviously paying attention to the game progression through the levels.
3)	Designers creates the first version of the sequence in a XLS sheet
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/519546ebd2a58cabd64a70865188b3976625cfff.jpg[/img]
4)	Simone and Kyle (tech and playtesters) implement the data structure in Unity, creating Hard difficulty level, then medium, then easy
5)	…they test it with the music in all the three difficulty levels
6)	They modify the data structure to have the best feeling between music and buttons actions. …back to 5)
7)	They are happy!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/94cddd591c9723dd6babf22139a60c74244a3578.jpg[/img]
8)	All the team plays so everyone is happy too!

And, again, sorry for my rough english!

notes.title: Let us introduce ourselves! The PRIDE RUN team!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
Here is Ivan Venturi, founder of IV Productions and Project Director of Pride Run!
Firstly, let me apologize for my rough english!

With a superbig pleasure, let me present you the team and in the meanwhile let me tell you a bit of the story of the development till now.

[b]START[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/5621602f0c184631060761eb3ce02b6b60347cc5.jpg[/img]
The 11th of october 2016 I had the very first idea and a very rough picture of what the game could be, and I spoke with Giacomo Guccinelli about it. He was immediately hitten and immediately he told me "YES, let's do it!". Then, thanks to the president of the LGBTQ+ cultural centre of Bologna (the city where I live and where IV Productions is), we got in touch with Hard Ton, AKA Mauro.

So, the base was there! Under a production point of view, Pride Run has three pillars. One of us for every pillar:
- tech, design, gameplay, production: Ivan
- art: Giacomo
- music: Mauro
We started prototyping. I programmed a couple of prototypes in Game Maker to see if the mechanics we imagined were good to fit with the music. We found our way!

[b]PRE-PRODUCTION[/b]
We began prototyping in Unity, while abandoning a first mechanics (a sort of initial game phase with the crowd movement through a tiled map) to enforce the other, called Street View.
Here the team in that moment (from left to right): Mauro, Davide, Max (in pixel art! Hard Ton singer), me, Giacomo, Katalin, Michele.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/7ffe369f0333d16eb30e4e336e5d8befc70ceca7.jpg[/img]
We produced a first playable version of the musical RTS game mode, now called PLAY HARD, and of the Dance Duel. We showed it in Lucca Comics & Games, just to understand what real players liked more or less. Moreover, we wanted to understand: how people will react to a game on the LGBTQ+ Prides?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/9f4858298aa8636a08ee869144b4dabae762528b.jpg[/img]
People loved it. We were there with a lot of friends and it was something like a party! But we discovered also that the RTS gameplay, as we implemented, was not in the right direction.
So, we threw away everything and we began to code from scratch.

Me, Giacomo and Mauro funded the project by ourselves and we produced the two game modes, this time working well, and 4 scenarios, even if not complete as they are now in the game. Anyway, it was enough to go to Paris to the Game Connection looking for a publisher.
Here, we met Jonny of Green Man Gaming!
Overally, the game had a huge success with publishers, everyone was interested and even we won two prizes. But we were looking to a specific publisher. One that would be able (and having the will) to deal with the unovoidable issues from haters and toxic people in the videogame market.
Just one thing: One Man Gaming changes its logo in a rainbow version for the Pride season. And more. To cut the long story short, we understood that GMG was our perfect publisher. The needed extension of our team.
We signed!

[b]PRODUCTION[/b]
We started the production, with additional collaborators working on graphics, musics, FX, data structures etc.
Here a picture we took with David, director of Green Man Gaming Publishing, who came in Bologna (after a supergreat lunch of tortellini in brodo).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/dd29cb5f880be700b372b6dd7bd6ba29c6bb9fc8.jpg[/img]
From left to right: Kyle, Davide, Michele, Luisa Maria, David, Marianna, Daniele, Giacomo, Massimo, me. Mauro is not in the picture as after lunch had to go somewhere. Moreover, we need to add Simone, Paride, Elena, Ilaria, who are not in the picture.

We can really say that we are a diverse team, under a LGBTQ+ point of view. We have all the colors of the rainbow in our team!

[b]NOW[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/057e10208f59f9040ea3df8f0795b5fe4f1ac970.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922079/8a26cf273be2e99dbc67f8b6c089986d13c8c98c.jpg[/img]

These pictures were taken some day ago, while the team was trying the Vanilla mode with the Dance Pad, where you push buttons with your feet. (btw: FANTASTIC!).

We are working hard to give you the best game as possible, for this autumn!
I'll keep you updated as I can, giving you a lot of info, but without doing too much spoiler about the game. We want you to be 200% surprised the first time you'll play the game!

Talk soon, and RUN PRIDE RUN!
